name: Body Scan Meditation
equipment: A quiet space to lie down (or sit comfortably)
instructions: Lie down or sit in a supported, comfortable position, and close your eyes.
Take several slow breaths, letting your body soften with each exhale.
Starting at your toes, bring curious attention to each part of your body in turn — feet, calves, knees, thighs, hips.
Continue scanning upward through your belly, chest, back, hands, arms, shoulders, neck, and face, noticing tension without forcing it to release.
If your mind drifts, gently return to the last body part you remember scanning.
Finish with a few breaths that take in your whole body at once, then slowly open your eyes.
